canon.hermon: the snow-streaked summit of Mount Hermon -- bare grey rock, thin cloud, open wilderness, no buildings, no city, no structures
canon.ridge: a bare highland ridgeline at night -- dry scrub, scattered pale boulders, one low stone wall, open wilderness, no buildings, no city, no modern objects
canon.cave: the Qumran cliffs above the Dead Sea -- pale limestone riddled with dark cave mouths, dry scree, the salt sea flat and bright below, open desert, no buildings, no modern objects
canon.babylon: the Mesopotamian plain at Babylon -- a colossal stepped ziggurat of mud brick rising over flat river country, palms and dust, open sky, no modern objects
